not-alone.title: Not Alone
not-alone.overview: While preparing for a revolutionary space launch, an introverted rocket mechanic and a brilliant astro-botanist spark an unexpected romance—only for three runaway aliens to crash-land in his home, looking for a ride back to the stars.
not-alone.cast: Timothée Chalamet, Selena Gomez, Rob Brydon, Diane Morgan, Jamie Demetriou, Brett Goldstein

spider-man-brand-new-day.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
spider-man-brand-new-day.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
spider-man-brand-new-day.cast: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Tramell Tillman

jackass-best-and-last.title: Jackass: Best and Last
jackass-best-and-last.overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.
jackass-best-and-last.cast: Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O, Chris Pontius, Jason 'Wee Man' Acuña, Dave England, Preston Lacy

supergirl.title: Supergirl
supergirl.overview: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.
supergirl.cast: Milly Alcock, Eve Ridley, Matthias Schoenaerts, Jason Momoa, David Krumholtz, Emily Beecham

the-invite.title: The Invite
the-invite.overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?
the-invite.cast: Seth Rogen, Olivia Wilde, Penélope Cruz, Edward Norton

wham-10-days-in-china.title: Wham! 10 Days in China
wham-10-days-in-china.overview: In 1985, Wham! were the first Western pop group to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s two concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introduced live Western pop to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. For Wham!, the tour was more than music; it was a bold move to capture American attention and launch them into global superstardom, and it worked.

minions-monsters.title: Minions & Monsters
minions-monsters.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.
minions-monsters.cast: Pierre Coffin, Trey Parker, Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg

before-the-last-octopus.title: Before the Last Goodbye
before-the-last-octopus.overview: Silva returns to his hometown on the outskirts of town after spending a few years elsewhere. He wants to apologize to Maria, his ex-girlfriend. But the young man also wants forgiveness from his best friend, who swore to kill him if he returned.
before-the-last-octopus.cast: Michael Di'Martino, Paulla Carniell, Gustavo Alves, Charles Alves

the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.title: Welcome to the Jungle
the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.overview: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.
the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.cast: Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, Arshad Warsi, Jacqueline Fernandez, Disha Patani, Raveena Tandon

backrooms-everything-must-go-edition-wit.title: Backrooms
backrooms-everything-must-go-edition-wit.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
backrooms-everything-must-go-edition-wit.cast: Chiwetel Ejiofor, Renate Reinsve, Mark Duplass, Finn Bennett, Lukita Maxwell, Avan Jogia
